checks.name: RQ-003 | Bronze lot L-2026-10-01 | taux de telephones renseignes
checks.definition:
checks for crm_client [lot]:
  - rq003_taux_telephone:
      name: RQ-003 | Bronze lot ${BATCH_ID} | taux de telephones renseignes
      rq003_taux_telephone query: |
        SELECT 100.0 * SUM(
                 CASE WHEN telephone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(telephone) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taux
        FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_client WHERE _batch_id = '${BATCH_ID}') lot_source
        WHERE LOWER(TRIM(type_personne)) = 'souscripteur'
      warn: when < 98

checks.name: RQ-018 | Bronze lot L-2026-10-01 | ecart nul entre les trois directions
checks.definition:
checks for crm_contrat [lot]:
  - rq018_ecart_directions:
      name: RQ-018 | Bronze lot ${BATCH_ID} | ecart nul entre les trois directions
      rq018_ecart_directions query: |
        SELECT MAX(nb_actifs) - MIN(nb_actifs) AS ecart
        FROM (
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id) AS nb_actifs
          FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = '${BATCH_ID}') c
          WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
          FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = '${BATCH_ID}') c
          WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
          UNION ALL
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
          FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = '${BATCH_ID}') c
          WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d')
            AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('${REFERENCE_DATE}', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        ) directions
      fail: when > 0

FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_client WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
WHERE c.pays IS NULL
   OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM silver.ref_pays p WHERE p.code_pays = c.pays
  )

queries.name: bronze.user_defined_query[rq015_prospects_avec_contrat]
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS nb
FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_client WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(c.type_personne)) IN ('prospect', 'prosp.')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') k WHERE k.souscripteur_id = c.client_id
  )

queries.name: bronze.user_defined_query[rq016_taux_souscripteurs_avec_contrat]
queries.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') k WHERE k.souscripteur_id = c.client_id
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS taux
FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_client WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(c.type_personne)) = 'souscripteur'

queries.name: bronze.user_defined_query[rq013_assures_orphelins_apres_nullif]
queries.sql:

FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c

queries.name: bronze.user_defined_query[rq018_ecart_directions]
queries.sql:
SELECT MAX(nb_actifs) - MIN(nb_actifs) AS ecart
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id) AS nb_actifs
  FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
  WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
  FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
  WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
  FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') c
  WHERE STR_TO_DATE(c.date_debut, '%Y-%m-%d') <= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_fin, '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.date_derniere_cotisation, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE('2026-10-01', '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
) directions

queries.name: bronze.user_defined_query[taux_erreur_adresse]
queries.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(b.id_ban IS NULL) / COUNT(*) AS taux_erreur
FROM (SELECT * FROM bronze.crm_sinistre WHERE _batch_id = 'L-2026-10-01') s
LEFT JOIN silver.ref_ban b
       ON CONCAT(b.numero, ' ', b.voie) = s.adresse_sinistre
      AND b.code_postal = s.cp_sinistre
      AND b.commune = s.ville_sinistre
